svg.text: eye_led_right5 mm white LED + 100 ohm resistor
eye_led_left5 mm white LED + 100 ohm resistor
regulator_doorsPololu D36V50F5 5 V 5.5 A step-down regulator
Inline ATM mini blade fuse holder
VBAT 7.2 V from SW1: load 2.72 A typical, 7.935 A peak; source 6 A cont, 10 A peak; fuse 4 A
5V_SERVO 5 V from U1: load 0.5 A typical, 1.4 A peak; source 2 A cont, 3 A peak
5V_LIGHTS 5 V from U2: load 0.72 A typical, 2.16 A peak; source 2 A cont, 3 A peak
5V_DOORS 5 V from U3: load 2.03 A typical, 6.03 A peak; source 5.5 A cont, 8 A peak
Fuses: F1 4 A (everything on VBAT), F2 2 A (branch regulator), F3 2 A (branch controller), F4 2 A (branch regulator_lights). Branch fuses sit inline in the lead
Lever splices (star_ground, splice_vbat, splice_5v_servo, splice_5v_lights, splice_5v_doors) are junctions of their nets.
Same net label or power symbol = same conductor. X = pin not connected.
